name: rentemester-imported-receivables-v36
sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS imported_receivable_headers (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  dinero_import_attempt_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES dinero_import_attempts(id),
  external_invoice_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(trim(external_invoice_id)) > 0),
  source_document_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(source_document_hash)=64),
  customer_external_id TEXT,
  customer_name TEXT,
  invoice_date TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(invoice_date)=10),
  due_date TEXT,
  gross_amount NUMERIC NOT NULL CHECK(gross_amount > 0),
  control_account_no TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts(account_no),
  source_recognition_ref TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(trim(source_recognition_ref)) > 0),
  schedule_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(schedule_hash)=64),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  UNIQUE(dinero_import_attempt_id, external_invoice_id)
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS imported_receivable_events (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  receivable_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES imported_receivable_headers(id),
  external_event_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(trim(external_event_id)) > 0),
  event_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(event_kind IN ('payment','credit_note')),
  effective_date TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(effective_date)=10),
  amount NUMERIC NOT NULL CHECK(amount > 0),
  source_event_ref TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(trim(source_event_ref)) > 0),
  source_document_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(source_document_hash)=64),
  schedule_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(schedule_hash)=64),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  UNIQUE(receivable_id, external_event_id)
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_imported_receivable_headers_control_date ON imported_receivable_headers(control_account_no,invoice_date);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_imported_receivable_events_receivable_date ON imported_receivable_events(receivable_id,effective_date);
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS imported_receivable_headers_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON imported_receivable_headers BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'imported receivables are append-only'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS imported_receivable_headers_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON imported_receivable_headers BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'imported receivables are append-only'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS imported_receivable_events_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON imported_receivable_events BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'imported receivables are append-only'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS imported_receivable_events_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON imported_receivable_events BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'imported receivables are append-only'); END;
